title: skill-check normalized trace
description: Canonical format for recording agent skill execution traces. All adapters (native, shim, parser, manual) produce this shape.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the run started.

ended_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the run ended.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata (CI job ID, git SHA, etc.).

id.description: Unique event ID within this trace (e.g. 'e1', 'evt_abc123').

type.description: Namespaced event type. See event families below.

name.description: Human-readable name scoped to the event type. For skill.activated this is the skill name; for hook.started this is the hook name; for command.executed this is the command string.

duration_ms.description: Duration of the event in milliseconds (for events that span time).

source.description: How this event was captured. native=agent adapter, shim=proxy/wrapper, parsed=log/transcript parser, manual=hand-authored.

confidence.description: Confidence that this event actually occurred as described.

parent_id.description: ID of the parent event, for nesting (e.g. a command.executed inside a hook.started/hook.succeeded pair).

error.description: Present only when the event represents a failure.
